questions: What is a mask?
If the mask comes off, is everything visible again?
What is compression?
When the compression is released, does it return to exactly the same shape?
What is matching?
If the matching fails, do the two still belong together?
How does tracking work?
If the tracking is lost, does it eventually catch up?
What is detection?
If detection fails, is it definitely not there?
What is capture?
If the capture fails, did it get away?
What is exposure?
If the exposure is increased, does more become visible?
How do you estimate depth?
If depth is missing, is it flat?
What is a transform?
If the transform is reversed, do you get exactly what you started with?
What is resolution?
If the resolution is higher, is the result always better?
What is stitching?
If the stitching comes loose, does it open up again?
What is stereo?
If the stereo loses one side, can you still tell how far away things are?
What is segmentation?
If the segmentation is removed, do the groups become one?
What is noise?
If the noise is removed, is everything else exactly unchanged?
What is a pose?
If the pose changes, has the person moved?
